title: Sage nav_area record
description: A nav_area record (NavAreaRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another nav_area record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

cost.description: What a metre of it costs a planner, against 1 for ground no area names: 0.5 a road, 3 mud. Range: 0.10000000149011612 to 100. (float, default 1)

forbidden.description: Factions that never plan a way through it, and stop at its edge. Names a faction record. (List<RecordRef<FactionRecord>>)

forbidden+.description: Adds to "forbidden": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

forbidden-.description: Removes these from "forbidden" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

surfaces.description: What ground made of these physics_materials is: a road's gravel, a bog's mud. Names a physics_material record. (List<RecordRef<PhysicsMaterialRecord>>)

surfaces+.description: Adds to "surfaces": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

surfaces-.description: Removes these from "surfaces" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

water.description: Every water volume is this area (one nav_area volume over it still wins) (bool, default false)

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.
